evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I jump in, I just wanna make sure that I answer the important questions for you. So do you have any of those [on your] mind?" — asked before probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "No, I mean just go ahead, ask away" — no concern raised up front; the later rate question got a full, thorough answer; scored 15 under the no-concern N/A rule.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you only pay for the time you use... if you get closer to that minimum, then that's all you'll pay for" (beats-it-pay-less) + a window statement tied to "no special consideration items in this move"; no commit-to-rate line, no self-prep tip, no "does that feel fair" + silence.

top_strength: Gives a clean, fully-itemized rate breakdown (movers, truck, disassembly, damage coverage, taxes, no hidden fees) the moment the customer asks about pricing — transparent and thorough.
coaching_note: Meet Your Mover and both Stage 2 takeaway items (On-Time Guarantee, Communication) never landed anywhere in the call — only damage coverage got mentioned; work in the other three differentiators before the estimate.
